scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow of an Ex-Serviceman of rank up to Havildar or equivalent
Applicant must have successfully completed the vocational training
Applicant must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB)
benefits_summary: A one‑time financial assistance of up to Rs.20,000 is provided to widows of Ex‑Servicemen on successful completion of the vocational training.
documents_required: Supporting documents attested by the respective Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO)
